en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far Al-Razzāz narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Muḥammad ibn Ismā’īl, from Al-Khaybari, from Ḥusain ibn Muḥammad Al-Qummi, who said:

Abul Ḥasan, Mūsā ibn Ja’far (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) said: The minimum reward for those who go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) by the shores of the Euphrates (River), while knowing his rights and believing in his sanctity and Wilāyah, is that all of their past and future sins will be forgiven.
